TC-21/S21.title: Context switcher on phone width and WebKit (web half)
TC-21/S21.detail: Local 25acd727, runnerGap R7 spec: Pixel 7 (Chromium, touch) and iPhone 15 (WebKit, touch), taps on the switcher. 8/8 judged: exactly one Hospital and one Nursing Home button and no Clinic on both lists in both engines; Quick Dictation on /rounding and absent on /snf; no row of the other context after the taps; the NH picker on the phone lists the 4 SNF templates. Left: the Android app half (background / resume) — see blockers.
